name: Generate descriptive text or prompts for visual images
description: Users asked to generate descriptive texts, captions, or prompts for images, artworks, and scenes, often specifying visual details, artistic styles, or technical parameters. The requests varied from creating natural language narratives for human or AI consumption to generating concise keyword lists for specific image generation tools, with some including metadata such as home decor suitability or fictional blog post formats.
